exclusion_population_rule: The exact frozen exclusion set applies unchanged to T0, T1, T2, and T3. It removes all post-T0 Issue #109/#114 Run 3 administrative Python machinery found by comparing T0 with the execution parent; no other related post-T0 Python files exist outside these directories.
measured_population_invariant: measured(Tn) = experimental system state excluding the frozen administrative research machinery, for every n
input_identity: Git commit and tree IDs are recorded for every Tn; T0 is f8e5a2c88f2ae7154052ffd90e225b1c2f3ab166 / 18cd9de245d2a0cdb73218ba500cc368485c71ac.
representation: Tracked-tree-equivalent .py files; module names are root-relative paths, __init__ maps to its package; AST Import aliases use alias.name and absolute ImportFrom uses node.module literally; only targets that exactly name an owned module form edges.
ordering: Nodes, two-string edges, SCC members, SCC list, violations, unmeasurable declarations, and deltas are lexicographically sorted and JSON keys are sorted.

output_schema.cycles: sorted SCC member lists (size >1 or self-loop)

baseline_semantics: The externally inspected historical T0 output is the fixed cumulative baseline; measuring it is administrative evidence, not a transition.
adjacent_comparison_rule: Set difference T(n-1) to Tn for nodes and edges.
cumulative_comparison_rule: Set difference T0 to every accepted Tn for nodes and edges.
withholding: Instrument, fixtures, specifications, and all structural outputs are withheld from candidate generation and the one candidate repair.

measures.violation_or_change_rule: a newly present matching static edge

measures.predicate: non-tests source to tests or tests.* target
measures.violation_or_change_rule: a newly present matching static edge
measures.interpretation_boundary: tests remain possible targets but test sources do not create this violation

measures.predicate: scripts.* or tools.* to investigations.*, or investigations.* to scripts.*
measures.violation_or_change_rule: a newly present matching static edge

measures.interpretation_boundary: static import cycles, not runtime recursion

measures.violation_or_change_rule: any nonempty delta is change, not inherently degradation

malformed_policy: Unreadable, undecodable, or unparsable Python is deterministically declared unmeasurable; malformed comparison JSON exits nonzero.
